facts.claim: Natural-language prompts are often too ambiguous to directly produce formal state-machine specifications without human clarification.
LLM-generated code can pass tests while still failing formal proof obligations or missing invariants.
Tool feedback loops with provers, SMT solvers, model checkers, or static analyzers are promising but still require careful orchestration.
